fact: In a statement dated 3 December 2024 the Mayor of Addis Ababa says birth, death, marriage and divorce registration is being replaced by a digital service across the agency's 132 service centres, with one centre in each woreda providing vital services daily and services monitored from the centre.
title: We are working on a model for our country with a modern and complete digital civil registration system
publisher: Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Residency Service Agency
